name: inkhaus
description: INKHAUS monorepo - Next.js storefront + admin back office + NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL API

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inkhaus/shared && npm run build -w @inkhaus/api && npm run build -w @inkhaus/web && npm run build -w @inkhaus/admin
scripts.//test:e2e: Browser tests for both sign-in flows - the storefront's and the back office's - plus the role rules. Needs Postgres up (npm run db:up); `test` above stays unit-only so it runs anywhere. Both suites build the API first because they run its compiled output, on their own ports, against the same database - which is why they run one after the other and not at once.
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:build && npm run test:e2e -w @inkhaus/admin && npm run test:e2e -w @inkhaus/web
scripts.test:e2e:build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @inkhaus/api
scripts.test:e2e:admin: npm run test:e2e:build && npm run test:e2e -w @inkhaus/admin
scripts.test:e2e:web: npm run test:e2e:build && npm run test:e2e -w @inkhaus/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate
